thread:
Maya Chen: Dropping a new prototype for the trace viewer focused on drilldowns and exports. link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz789/trace-drilldown-v2
Priya Nair: Quick thoughts: the left timeline is dense. consider grouping spans by service and showing an aggregate bar for repeated identical spans with count badge. reduces vertical height.
Jordan Patel: Grouping is good. also add a small chevron to expand collapsed groups. default to collapsed when >5 repeats.
Theo Ruiz: UX nit: when a user clicks a span we show a flyout, but it steals vertical space. prefer a right-side persistent panel so keyboard users don't lose context.
Maya Chen: Right-side panel makes sense. will change mock to persistent.
Samir Khan: A11y: ensure panel has aria-modal=false and role=dialog only if it traps focus. If it's persistent, use role=region and aria-live=polite for dynamic updates.
Priya Nair: For stack traces, show top 3 frames by default and a "Show all frames" link. also add a toggle to switch between formatted frames and raw JSON.
Jordan Patel: Add a small "Copy full trace link" action next to trace id. deep link should include ?trace_id=...&from=console so support can open exact view.
Maya Chen: Copy link action should have microcopy "Link copied to clipboard" and a small check animation.
Theo Ruiz: Export options: mock shows CSV/JSON. suggest adding "Export .zip (trace + frames)" which bundles JSON trace + NDJSON frames + metadata.json. helpful for ingestion.
Samir Khan: From infra: when exporting large traces, server side should return a pre-signed URL and notify via an aria-live alert when ready. UI needs to show progress and a friendly size estimate before kicking off.
Priya Nair: Include an option in export modal: "Flatten spans for CSV (boolean)" with a short help icon that explains how nested spans map to rows.
Maya Chen: Good. Also thinking about correlation IDs: make them searchable; clicking the pill opens a mini timeline of related traces (3 most recent) inline.
Jordan Patel: We should surface correlation ID provenance: a small badge that indicates origin (ingest header vs generated). copy should include full id and a short id for chat.
Theo Ruiz: Keyboard: Tab order must go: timeline -> group chevrons -> span -> panel actions -> export button. Add visible focus ring and shortcut hint "/" to focus search.
Samir Khan: Color accessibility: heatmap uses teal/orange. add pattern overlays or shape variants for high contrast mode. also allow users to switch to a dyslexia-friendly font in settings.
Maya Chen: Nice to include preferences. small copy question: should we label the drilldown button "Open request" or "Show request details"?
Priya Nair: "Show request details" is clearer for new users.
Jordan Patel: Backend note: we'll attach a stable short link token so exported metadata includes "trace_short_url" and a "signed_until" timestamp for private traces.
ops-bot: Alert: Payment service error burst at 04:12 UTC. sample correlation ID: 3f9b2a.
Theo Ruiz: ops-bot pin idea: allow dragging an alert into the trace viewer to auto-filter traces around that timestamp. saves time during incidents.
Maya Chen: Love that. final checklist: group repeated spans by default, persistent right panel with aria roles, stack trace collapse, export zip + pre-signed flow, export size estimate modal, correlation ID search + provenance badge, keyboard order + shortcuts, high-contrast/pattern options, ops-bot drag-to-filter. I'll iterate and post updated frames tomorrow.
Samir Khan: I'll run an accessibility pass after the next mock. please include unit tests for keyboard and aria attributes.
Jordan Patel: We'll add the export metadata fields to the API schema. thanks team.
